name: Brand Loader Reveal
description: A full-screen brand-color loader with a centered logo mark that lifts away like a curtain once the page has loaded, then staggers the hero content in with small fade-and-rise steps.
usage: Paste the .blr-loader overlay as the first child of <body>, add .blr-stagger plus one of .blr-d1 to .blr-d6 to each hero element, link styles.css and script.js, then call initLoaderReveal({ minTime: 1200, onRevealed: fn }).
source: Pattern seen on https://coffee-tech.com (Awwwards SOTD by MAKETHECUT and Or Halevi), implemented from scratch
